QuestInfo.name: Royal Errands
QuestInfo.0: Your path is set. Gain experience, increase your level, and save your people from their terrible curse! First thing you need to do is learn more about the new Maple World. #b#p1032112##k might know a thing or two that will help you out.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032112# says that #b#p1012111##k in #b#m100040000##k is looking for someone to do errands for her. Maybe it's beneath you, the high-and-mighty ruler of the Elves, but it's all you can do for now. Go see #p1012111#.
QuestInfo.2: There is a big town in the #m100000000# Plains. #p1012111# says he is studying #o9101054#s and asked for your help. He says he'll also reward you... From monarch to errand monkey... Life is strange, isn't it?

0.0: Hey, you cheered up! You decide to be a normal person, like I said?\r\n#L0##bNo, of course not. Say, do you know what kind of work is out there for someone of my level?#l\n#k
0.1: Hm... Well, there's not a whole lot out there for a little acorn like you. Oh, but there IS that researcher in #b#m100040000##k. Dr. #p1012111#, I believe it was. He was looking for someone to run some errands. How 'bout that?\r\n#L0##bErrands? You're telling the sovereign of the Elves to run errands?#l\n#k
0.2: Soverwhat of the who? You really are weird, aren't you? If Dr. #p1012111# thinks I'm sending crazies his way, he'll chop me down...\r\n#L0##bAh, I'm just... kidding. You don't have to worry about me. I'm very... good... at errands.#l\n#k
0.3: Hmph. You're weird, but you seem harmless enough. Okay, go into #b#m100040000##k and tell Dr. #p1012111# I sent ya.

yes.0: I hope you know the way to #b#m100040000##k. Pass through #m104020000# to go to #m100000000#. #m100040000# will be further south. Ask a tree if you get lost.
yes.1: Seriously though, press the #bW#k key for the world map if you get lost. Dr. #b#p1012111##k has ashen hair and a white lab coat. Y'know, like a doctor.

no.0: Well, I WAS going to put in a good word with Dr. Betty for you, but now I'm not so sure!

1.0: I am #p1012111#, Golem researcher extraordinaire! What business do you have with me? Is it Golem stuff?\r\n#L0#I am here on behalf of #b#p1032112#. I hear that you need an a... a... assistant.#l\n#k
1.1: You're here for the job? Marvelous! I'm in DIRE need of an assistant. It doesn't pay much, but if you're willing to start right away, the job is yours.

npc.0: Why aren't you talking to #b#p1012111##k already! He's in #m100040000#. If you're lost, press the #bW#k key to look at the world map!
